## Setup

```{r loading packages}
# Loading packages 
library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
```

```{r}
# Imoprting dataset
country.df <- read_csv("Data/Processed/AllCountries_Processed.csv")
```
## Summary table

```{r summary table}
# Selecting relevant numeric variables
numeric_vars <- c(
  "HouseholdSize",
  "DwellingRoomsNumber",
  "NumYearsGridConnected",
  "GridConnectionFeeUSD",
  "InternalWiringFeeUSD",
  "ElectricityBillPriceUSD",
  "OutageDurationHours",
  "ElectricityConsumptionkWh",
  "EstimateOfElectricitySpendingUSD"
)

# Sorting and calculating descriptive statistics
summary_table <- country.df %>% 
  summarise(across(
    all_of(numeric_vars), 
    list(
      N = ~sum(!is.na(.)),
      Missing = ~sum(is.na(.)),
      Mean = ~mean(., na.rm=TRUE),
      Median = ~median(., na.rm=TRUE),
      SD = ~sd(., na.rm=TRUE),
      Min = ~min(., na.rm=TRUE),
      Max = ~max(., na.rm=TRUE)
    )
  )) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to = c("Variable", ".value"), 
               names_pattern = "^(.*)_(N|Missing|Mean|Median|SD|Min|Max)$")

kable(
  summary_table,
  caption = "Descriptive Statistics of Household-Level Variables",
  col.names = c(
    "Variable", "Valid Observations", "Missing Values", 
    "Mean", "Median", "SD", "Min", "Max"
  )
)

```


## Figure: Urban-rural divide 
```{r}
urban_rural <- country.df %>%
  filter(!is.na(UrbanOrRural), 
         GridConnected %in% c(1,2),
         UrbanOrRural %in% c(1,2)) %>%
  mutate(
    UrbanOrRural = factor(UrbanOrRural,
                          levels = c(1,2), 
                          labels = c("Urban", "Rural"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(Country, UrbanOrRural) %>%
  summarise(
    Connection_Rate = mean(GridConnected == 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(urban_rural, aes(x=Country, y=Connection_Rate, 
                        fill=UrbanOrRural)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) # presenting y axis as %
  labs(
    title = "Urban vs Rural Comparison of Electricity Access", 
    x = "Country", 
    y = "Connection Rate (%)",
    fill = "Urban or Rural"
  ) +
    theme_minimal()
```
